taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Account recovery and password-reset binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace reset request, recipient selection, token generation/storage, validation, password commit and session policy. Record which account and purpose a token is bound to.
controls.controlled_verification: With two controlled accounts and a local/owned mailbox, request A's reset and compare the token's validated account with any caller-supplied account/recipient field at consumption. Complete one intended reset, then make a bounded reuse attempt against the same fixture token. Inspect account credential state, not just response text.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A reset email arriving or a token being visible to its intended recipient is normal. A generic success response can hide rejection. Password policy or mail enumeration observations are different root causes.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind recipient, account, purpose, lifetime and one-time consumption atomically. Retest wrong-account consumption, reuse and valid recovery; assess session invalidation against the product's declared contract.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
